name: mRobust04
description: Robust 2004 is an information retrieval benchmark whose large number of judgments per query make it a reliable evaluation dataset. In this paper, we present mRobust04, a multilingual version of Robust04 that was translated to 8 languages using Google Translate. We also provide results of three different multilingual retrievers on this dataset. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/unicamp-dl/mrobust
reputation: A multilingual adaptation of the well-known Robust04 IR benchmark; useful for multilingual retrieval research but less widely adopted than larger contemporary multilingual IR datasets.
notes: Translated automatically with Google Translate, so translations may introduce noise and artifacts; relatively small query set compared to modern corpora; potential contamination risk for large pre-trained models; not specifically designed for LLMs (traditional IR focus).
